videos.title: These Features Should Be Added to Create Mod! - Create Connected

order.note: FIRST thing the guide demonstrates, and correctly so - the crank wheel is a hand crank with a cogwheel built in, so it is relevant from the player's very first manual power setup. Identical stress and speed to a vanilla hand crank, but half the footprint.
Second tier: the inverted clutch and inverted gearshift. Both exist to delete a multi-block redstone workaround players otherwise build by hand.
Third: the gearbox family. Base Create's gearbox flips rotation direction every 90 degrees; the parallel gearbox makes every output turn the same way. The six-way adds two more shafts.
TOP TIER, explicitly called a tier step up by the guide: the brass gearbox gives per-face control of rotation direction, right-click to flip each face.

gates.note: HARD GATE that will stump players: the linked transmitter CANNOT be placed on the ground. It must be right-clicked onto a lever, and it only transmits - it needs a normal Create redstone link on the receiving end.

GOTCHA: the six-way gearbox runs its two extra shafts at HALF speed, and the horizontal and vertical versions put the half-speed outputs on different shafts. This is the one thing the guide warns about explicitly.
Limitation: the brass gearbox exists only as four-sided horizontal and vertical variants. There is no six-way brass gearbox, so full directional control and six outputs are mutually exclusive.

PACK-LEVEL CONFLICT, critical if both mods ship together: Create Connected has its own copycat blocks that silently MIGRATE into Create Copycats+ blocks when Copycats+ is installed. Never write a quest that requires a create_connected:copycat_* item to be held or submitted while Copycats+ is present - the item will turn into the copycats: version. Migration is controlled by config checkboxes that are ON by default.

The centrifugal clutch only passes rotation above a set RPM. Its intended use is the classic steam engine bootstrap problem - a hand crank that would otherwise overstress the network the moment you attach the rest of the build.

traps.note: TRAP: the brake is a whole-network kill switch, not a local one, and it works by dumping enormous stress - two brakes are needed to stall a creative motor. The guide tests pairing a brake with a clutch to stop vehicle wheels faster and finds it does nothing.
Minor trap: Create Connected's plain copycat block has no clear purpose since a copycat already needs a block to copy. Even the guide cannot name a use for it.
Low-confidence item: the guide cannot explain what the fan freezing catalyst does. Not a good quest target without independent verification.

signature.note: The mod's stated whole point: control over rotation. Gearboxes, clutches and gearshifts are named in the opening sentence as the core focus, and they take the largest share of runtime by far.

Stress-management pair with no equivalent in base Create. The overstress clutch uncouples an overloaded branch so you can prioritise which half of a network survives; the shear pin sacrifices itself to protect the rest.
Both exist purely to fix an orientation limitation in base Create - item vaults cannot stack vertically and fluid tanks cannot lie horizontally. Heavily explained, clearly valued.

Given a very long dedicated segment - a sequenced gearshift for redstone signals, with timed outputs, counted loops, infinite loops, wait-for-edge and conditional loops. Length of explanation marks it as a flagship block.
Neatly encases the campfire, soul campfire, water or lava behind a bulk-processing fan so the hazard and mess disappear. A quality-of-life fix players immediately understand.
Compactness blocks. The encased chain cogwheel merges the encased chain drive and encased cogwheel; the freewheel clutch is a one-way rotation valve.
